name.description: Theme name. Sets the file name and the [data-theme] selector.
name.x-prompt: What should the theme be called?

project.description: The project to add the theme to. Defaults to the workspace's default project.

path.description: Directory for the theme file, relative to the project source root.

extends.description: Name of a theme to derive from. The generated file overrides only the tokens you change and inherits the rest.
